capabilities: Connect GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo and Codeberg servers
Sync issues and pull requests into Markdown notes
Apply filename and content templates with variables and conditions
Filter items by labels, assignees and reviewers
Show projects and issue boards as read-only Kanban views
disambiguation: Not a Git client; it only imports issues and pull requests as notes.
extras: Read-only: the plugin never changes anything on the Git servers. Supports self-hosted GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo servers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring issues and pull requests from Git hosting services into the vault as notes.

relations.evidence: The first version of the settings was inspired by schaier-io
Persist blocks were inspired by the Zotero Integration

requires.name: GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo or Codeberg account

summary: Plugin that syncs issues and pull requests from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo and Codeberg into Markdown notes.
